title: LinkedIn feed scanner: save good posts to MD + Korean spike notify
desc: Scans LinkedIn feed via CDP every 2h. Detects posts by keyword relevance, saves to linkedin-feed/YYYY-MM-DD_slug.md, notifies via pending_prompts (Korean message). Deduplicates via li_seen_posts.json.
steps: Scan: python resume/scripts/linkedin_feed_monitor.py scan (CDP port 9222 required)
Post from file: python resume/scripts/linkedin_feed_monitor.py post <file.txt>
Cron 2h: wkappbot cron add --interval 2h 'python D:/GitHub/personal-docs/resume/scripts/linkedin_feed_monitor.py scan' --cwd D:/GitHub/personal-docs
Dedup: resume/scripts/li_seen_posts.json auto-managed. Reset by deleting file.
Notify format: Korean spike via pending_prompts listing author + preview + filename

requirements.cmd: python -c "from pathlib import Path; print('ok' if Path('resume/scripts/linkedin_feed_monitor.py').exists() else 'no')"

author: claude
